settings_panel.title: Settings
settings_panel.general.title: General Settings
settings_panel.general.description: You can master the general settings of LigHTTP.
settings_panel.general.settings_file.des: Open the LigHTTP settings file location in your file manager.
settings_panel.general.settings_file.ope: Unable to open the settings file location. Please try again later.
settings_panel.general.language.label: Interface Language
settings_panel.general.language.descript: Select the language to be used in the interface.
Choose what to show the next time the application starts. Resuming restores request drafts, but not responses.
settings_panel.general.check_update_when: When enabled, the application will automatically check for new versions when it starts up.
settings_panel.http_client.title: HTTP Client Settings
settings_panel.http_client.description: Configure reqwest request behavior. Changes are saved automatically and apply to all subsequent requests.
settings_panel.http_client.timeout.label: Total Request Timeout (seconds)
settings_panel.http_client.timeout.descr: Total time from connecting until the response body is fully read. Default: 30 seconds. Range: 0–86400; 0 disables this limit.
settings_panel.http_client.connectTimeou: Time allowed to establish a connection. Default: 10 seconds. Range: 0–86400; 0 disables this limit.
settings_panel.http_client.readTimeout.d: Maximum wait for each read, resetting after a successful read. Range: 0–86400. Default: 0 (no limit).
settings_panel.http_client.followRedirec: Follow redirect responses automatically. When disabled, display the original 3xx response.
Maximum redirects per request. Exceeding the limit returns an error. Default: 10. Range: 1–100.
settings_panel.http_client.referer.label: Automatically Send Referer
settings_panel.http_client.referer.descr: Let reqwest set the Referer header automatically when following redirects. Enabled by default.
settings_panel.http_client.httpsOnly.des: Reject HTTP requests and redirects to HTTP when enabled. Disabled by default.
settings_panel.themes.title: Theme Settings
settings_panel.themes.description: Make your own LigHTTP in this page!
settings_panel.themes.theme_selection.de: Enter a direct image URL to use as the application's background image.
settings_panel.themes.background_image_o: Set the opacity of the background image, ranging from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully opaque).
settings_panel.themes.background_image_b: Set the blur level of the background image.
settings_panel.themes.binary_editor_them: Select the theme style for the binary editor.
settings_panel.themes.zoom_ratio.label: Zoom Ratio
settings_panel.themes.zoom_ratio.descrip: Set the zoom ratio, which affects the display scale of the editor content. You can also use Ctrl+滚轮 to adjust.
settings_panel.themes.color_theme.label: Interface Color Theme
settings_panel.themes.color_theme.descri: Import or switch LigHTTP .lhtheme.css theme files.
settings_panel.update.title: Check for Updates
settings_panel.update.up_to_date: You are using the latest version!
settings_panel.update.no_release_notes: No release notes available. Please visit the GitHub page for details ( {url} )
settings_panel.define_gen.title: Definition Generator Settings
settings_panel.define_gen.description: Set the behavior of QuickType to match your development habits
settings_panel.define_gen.indent.label: Default Indent Size
settings_panel.define_gen.indent.descrip: Set the number of spaces to use for indentation in the generated structure definitions. Default is 2. This setting may be overridden by certain generators.
settings_panel.define_gen.only_types.des: When enabled, the generator will only produce type definitions without the parsing functions. This is useful for scenarios that require pure type information.
settings_panel.define_gen.all_as_optiona: When enabled, the generator will set all properties as optional. This is useful for scenarios that involve handling potentially missing data.
